svg.title: 応募情報から履歴書を作成し、Gmailで送付する
svg.desc: Googleスプレッドシート、中央のGmail、Googleドキュメントと履歴書のアイコンを矢印でつないだ概念図。
svg.metadata:
Icon sources for google-forms-profile.svg
The thumbnail is an original layout assembled from the following real source icons. No AI-generated image or simulated application screenshot is used.
Google Sheets logo (Google): https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Google_Sheets_2020_Logo.svg Original SVG: https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/a/ae/Google_Sheets_2020_Logo.svg Wikimedia Commons identifies this simple-geometric logo as public domain (PD-shape).
Gmail logo (Google): https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Gmail_icon_(2020).svg Original SVG: https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/7/7e/Gmail_icon_%282020%29.svg Wikimedia Commons identifies this logo as public domain (PD-textlogo).
Google Docs logo (Google): https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Google_Docs_2020_Logo.svg Original SVG: https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/6/66/Google_Docs_2020_Logo.svg Wikimedia Commons identifies this logo as public domain (PD-textlogo / PD-shape).
Google product logos are used to identify the services discussed. Google retains its relevant trademark rights. This is an independently authored tutorial.
Resume icon: Bootstrap Icons, file-earmark-person. https://icons.getbootstrap.com/icons/file-earmark-person/ https://github.com/twbs/icons/blob/main/icons/file-earmark-person.svg The source icon is tagged cv/resume by Bootstrap Icons and licensed under MIT. Only scaling, position and inherited foreground color are changed.
